<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex014022026-09-2303-21-57" status="reviewed">dgos pa ni lam 
shes kyi rtogs bya lam bden la nyer dgu 'byung ba de bden pa dang po gsum gyi steng du nyer 
dgu 'byung bas yin no snyam <lb n="119a6"/> du yul dang yul can gyi 'brel ba go ba yin no || dngos la 
gnod pa ni gsum po'i rnam pa lam shes kyi rtogs byar 'gal ba'o || 
des na yul can lam shes kyi rtogs bya'i ming gis yul lam bden gyi rtogs bya la btags so <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3820">'dul</rs></note> gsung ngo  || </seg></TEI>
